description: This file defines the 'ThreadRAII' class within the 'Utils' namespace. The class manages a std::thread object, ensuring it is joined upon destruction to prevent resource leaks. It supports move semantics and incorporates exception handling during thread joining. The file serves as a utility helper for resource management related to threading.

classes.name: ThreadRAII
classes.description: A RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) class that manages a std::thread object, ensuring it is properly joined before destruction, with support for move semantics and exception handling.

methods.description: Destructor that attempts to join the managed thread if it is joinable, with exception handling and logging.
